narrative.northStar: The Studio Proof Contact Sheet & Floating Rail
narrative.overview: The Kenneth Bulaga Portfolio pairs the tactile intimacy of a double-framed floating left navigation rail with the analytical clarity of an architectural contact sheet. Rather than hiding production work behind decorative gradients or generic SaaS cards, the interface treats every deployed platform as a numbered, inspectable proof frame backed by verified database and financial metrics.
keyCharacteristics: Asymmetric two-zone desktop shell: a sticky 264px double-framed left rail paired with a wide 980px proof stage.
Contact-sheet project frames with numbered screenshot switchers (01–06) and primitive cutaway callouts explaining the exact engineering mechanism in view.
High-contrast tabular production scale ledger (7,125 Google SSO Accounts, PHP 707,750 Tracked SSC Clearance Ledger, 4,632+ Citizen Feedback Records, 0 Overlaps).
Tactile micro-craft: pixel-block canvas name resolution on initial load, 5-line ink click burst, and one-click green copy-email pill.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Emerald (#22c55e) appears only on live status indicators, verified proof icons, and the primary rail CTA. Never use decorative secondary accents that compete with real application screenshots.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Never stack an uppercase or monospace eyebrow label directly above an h1, h2, h3, or h4. Place frame indices, role counts, and status badges inline on the right side of a horizontal header row or beneath the heading.

rules.name: The Zero Ghost-Card Rule
rules.body: Never combine a 1px border with a soft ambient drop shadow on content cards. Cards sit flat on the canvas with crisp 1px borders and subtle border-contrast shifts on hover.

dos: Do keep all project copy, metrics, and screenshot primitives in src/data/portfolio.ts as the single source of truth.
Do pair every multi-screenshot gallery with numbered frame tabs (01–06) and a primitive callout strip.
Do use 16px Lucide stroke icons for all UI indicators and actions.
donts: Don't stack uppercase/monospace eyebrows above headings (h1–h4).
Don't combine borders and drop shadows on cards (ghost_card anti-pattern).
Don't use Unicode symbols or emojis in place of Lucide icons or monospace tokens.
